verified_chains.assessment: MassOnly is prepared only while the actual prior-exchange fact is absent. A successful existing sparse exchange read establishes the fact; exchange clear and geometry replacement clear it; same-wall owner migration swaps it. The valid-history route skips program resampling, H2D and BVP. Fixed 5f and current both return success in the pinned cold fixture; mass changes 0 to -0.013 and SST Co changes, while maximum Co is unchanged in that fixture.

Original four SST D2D backup/restore copies remain. Actual missing input is propagated through the first existing maximum traversal; no additional reduction, full snapshot or availability array is introduced. All maximum/reduction and copy error returns remain connected to caller restore.

A stale/unprepared callback invokes the real producer, then refreshes selected actual bulk and species fluxes through the common face body. Mechanical pressure is recovered from refreshed momentum; actual packet/ledger is then formed. The normal prepared-stage control records zero extra profile calls; changed stage records one. Static supplied wall velocity retains actual zero sweep/pressure-work channels.

Existing strict recovery is first; the existing real completePredictorGas body is shared unchanged. Actual OpenFOAM 10 CpuMaterialDriver inclusion and surface/geometry code are linked in the saved native CPU test; fixed 5f fails owner sampling and current completes four faces/two knots. Missing supplied gas remains an error.

Real old/new-volume half kernels are each captured before overwrite. Commit adds both distinct audit records to previous cumulative state, including actual integrated time and all residual/error fields. Int overflow uses defined same-width wrap rather than rejecting physical completion. Download occurs once at commit, with true copy failure restoring microBase. Existing targeted probes cover distinct volumes, terminal audit publication, second-capture failure and commit-copy failure.

Normal finite Co/cap expressions remain. Invalid/exhausted subdivision uses actual remaining/reference duration and only advances after real commit. Paid/zero windows are true no-ops. Existing host geometry completion paths handle numerical strict failures and common RK2/3 paths are used. Execution options select actual SST import; missing supplied SST does not invent inventory. Restore poison depends on actual CudaFault failure; corrected host missing-data retry and actual copy poison are separately evidenced.

A public currentCo failure restores the physical snapshot, whose uploadState clears cell/face status before the next public attempt. Sticky InvalidStorage is not carried into a normal corrected public retry. If the restore itself lacks host backing, caller can supply it and retry rollback/begin; actual CUDA restore failure remains poisoned.
